reviews.author: Dianna Kay
reviews.text: Awesome breakfast this morning.  Bacon, eggs, biscuits, gravy, cereal, waffles, bread, milk, yogurt and juice. No, I didn't eat it all. 😀 Room was very clean and comfortable.  Great beds. Quiet room. Good shower. Staff was so very nice and friendly. Thank you

reviews.author: Ruth Odom Merritt
reviews.text: This is the 3rd hotel we have stayed at in the area and is the only one worthy of this review. Staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast was great. Inside pool open 24 hours. The room had everything we needed in it and had comfy bedding. Staff gave my child a beach ball to play with in the pool. Everything was great. I wish I would’ve found this hotel on my first trip here.

reviews.author: Mandy Underwood
reviews.text: I cannot say enough wonderful things about our stay! We came in to town for my son’s graduation from boot camp and I am so glad we stayed here! The rooms were clean, the beds were comfy, and the staff were amazing! They were so friendly and accommodating….I especially need to mention Anjelica. She was so helpful and a joy to interact with! I highly recommend staying here and we definitely will if we are in the area again!

reviews.author: John H
reviews.text: Small but comfortable room, decent walk-in shower, Wi-Fi better than most places Ive been. Indoor pool is a nice touch. Warm/cold breakfast optionsm would stay here again

reviews.author: Charlie Parker
reviews.text: Room was clean and comfortable.  Bathroom was clean. Staff was always willing to help with any questions we had. If your staying for someone in the military it is very convenient to to base. I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Alicia Smith
reviews.text: Close to the Ft. Leanord Wood base(4 miles). Facility was clean and nice. Parking lot was safe and well lit. Front desk was friendly and helpful. Check-in went smoothly. Rooms were so nice and clean. We reserved one with a couch for 6 people and it worked perfectly on family day we had plenty of space to visit and hang out off base. Indoor pool was nice. Breakfast was exceptional, with lots of options and fresh fruit. We had no complaints. We would definitely stay again if we come to this area.

reviews.author: Dorothy Mahieu
reviews.text: Good place to stay to visit places close to Sullivan, MO.

reviews.author: pam bellamy
reviews.text: Nice updated, very friendly staff and quiet. Would stay again!

reviews.author: Sharese B.
reviews.text: The front desk staff, I believe their name was Ash, was so nice. I did the early online check in and my room and room keys were all ready. My room was very clean, quiet and the bed was VERY comfortable. There was a free breakfast but I decided to eat at Cracker Barrel next door. I did take a peek and the breakfast lookes pretty good. I will definitely stay again when I'm in the area.

reviews.author: Dani Danyluk
reviews.text:
This hotel was a huge surprise. Sullivan is a smaller town and there were not a lot of options for hotels. I selected the Comfort Inn  and am so happy with our choice. The pre-check-in saved me time but the person who checked me in was extremely welcoming and pleasant. Our room was the best we’ve stayed in for awhile.  It was roomy, clean and comfortable. The bed was so comfortable, the couch in our room had a footstool so we could truly relax. Then I was able to e-checkout to let them know we’d left. All around great experience and we will book again as we make this trip at least once a year.
Last, there were a lot of restaurants, both chain and local. I love Mexican food as it’s hard to get in Canada so we went to El Nopal. It was fantastic and just what we were looking for after a very long day on the road.

reviews.author: Scott Dickmeyer
reviews.text:
VERY clean hotel with an updated interior.  We stayed in a pet-friendly room on the first floor but did not have our pets with us.  Liked the laminate flooring.
The furniture and fixtures were new and fresh looking.  In addition, the gentleman at the check-in desk was friendly and professional.  I recommend this hotel right off of I44 in Sullivan, MO.

reviews.author: Dawn Smith
reviews.text:
TLDR: they have security cameras to monitor the parking lot!! ♡ Better than Hiltons rooms.

Moving cross country, we needed to stop before St. Louis. The reviews at prior hotels made me apprehensive to stop, with a loaded UHaul that would be sitting, unmonitored while we slept.

Then I came across Comfort Inn Sullivan.
From check in, with a very polite young man, who was very helpful in reassuring me my UHaul would be safe ...
To opening the door to our hotel room.
I have stayed at many Hiltons before. This room exceeded Hilton standards. Almost put them to shame actually! Filled with amenities, clean, and even the temperature was set, so the room was warm and welcoming at 9pm!

Stay here. You wont regret it!

reviews.author: Kenzie B
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 days while seeing the Meramac Caverns and Johnson Shut- Ins. Rooms were very clean, pool could use a good scrub around the edge but still clean. Would recommend for family's. Breakfast didn't have mucj options but was still good.

reviews.author: Bill Thibodeau
reviews.text: There's some renovations going on, the lobby is not complete yet, but is not an issue. It should look very nice when completed. Was really surprised at the quality and convenience of the redone rooms... shows attention to detail unlike we've seen in the past. All the furniture matched, quality wall coverings, some very convenient details... plug ins, switches, etc., and seemed to be good quality. The larger TV's that you can finally adjust the angle towards the seating area, and the mood lighting was a classy touch. One thing was not good... the pull down shade is see through, so does not block out the parking lot floods... we had to improvise a solution, and it provides little privacy. Should be an easy fix. We hope Choice continues to improve some of their locations, as some are really poor, and some should be closed, yet show a good rating, which makes one wonder about the rating process!

reviews.author: Charles Herman
reviews.text: Can't beat this place for the price. Big clean updated rooms. Super friendly and accommodating staff. Wish I would have gotten the lady working the front desk name she was amazing.

reviews.author: Richard Mommers
reviews.text: Clean and nice shower

reviews.author: Ikey Alvarez
reviews.text: The place was clean and Staff was Nice Katie was especially helpful would stay here again and recommend to friends

reviews.author: LK S
reviews.text: Great stay for the price. Clean, comfortable and quiet. Soft towels are always a plus and appreciated. Staff were very friendly.

reviews.author: Amy Yokum
reviews.text: The location was where we needed to stop.  I was skeptical at first because this location was significantly less expensive than others nearby but it had good ratings (always check the ratings) and a quick peek on Google earth confirmed they did indeed have RV parking available for the RV we are transporting.  The front desk person Jeremiah was awesome!  We got our room quickly and were so pleasantly surprised - I wish I would have taken photos.  The room was clean and sheets were free of stains.  The bathroom was clean and the water pressure in the shower was amazing!  We stay in hotels traveling full time so this was a big deal and a great surprise

reviews.author: Garry Tebbens
reviews.text: Great stop for overnight stop. Not fancy. Easy access from highway. Good efficient staff. Room you was well taken care of, very clean. They have coffee and tea, no breakfast. Still an excellent value. Would stay again.

reviews.author: Steve Oladeji
reviews.text:
The hotel was a pleasant surprise—clean, neat, and well-maintained throughout. The bathroom was spotless, which is always a top priority for me. Staff were friendly and attentive, making the stay even more comfortable. The location was convenient, with easy access to nearby attractions. Small touches like fresh linens and a quiet atmosphere added to the overall positive experience. Would gladly stay here again.

What stood out most to me during my stay is the serenity.

reviews.author: Michael Souder
reviews.text:
My stay was good, room was very clean and organized. Only reason for a missing star was the gap under the door(fixed by using a towel). The manager was incredibly courteous even mentioned that the door seals were part of off season fixes.
Thank you

reviews.author: Joan Olveda
reviews.text:
Just off the highway but very quiet. We're traveling with our dog. The room is very clean. No pet odor (my dog is the odor tester, no running around the room sniffing here! )
Great stop on our way west.
Make sure you stop at Uranus...truly one of a kind!
Also nice dog park 5 minutes away
